title: The Eye of Eternity
body: The Eye of Eternity is Malygos's own domain at the heart of the Nexus, a platform hanging in a starry void that can be reached only through the focusing iris. It is a realm of his making, where he claims the rules of reality do not apply, and here all the magic he drains from the world gathers around him in the dark.

parts.body: Krasus brings the judgment of the other Aspects: Malygos cannot be brought back into the fold, and the Spell-Weaver must be put down.
In his realm Malygos offered one chance to pledge fealty. Then he blamed reckless, careless mortals for the war, and accepted their extinction if that was the price.

His last words were for his sister: the mortals would destroy everything. Alexstrasza answered that he had given her no alternative, declared the Nexus War ended, and said she would mourn him, once a guardian.
Magic is now without its guardian, Krasus said. He hoped the decision would prove wise, for a storm was still brewing and the world had lost one of its mightiest defenders.

notes: Rewritten 2026-10-25 for the reorganization pilot: shorter, context first.
